highlights: AGENTS.md at root is the universal cross-tool file (read by Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode; GitHub Copilot uses .github/copilot-instructions.md instead)
Available in release 2.2: guided package setup for Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi Code
Skills format (SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter) works across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
DRY adapter pattern lets Cursor reuse Claude Code's hook scripts without duplication
